adjudication.rationale: The migration `20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb` inserts legacy `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts` lines directly via SQL: `VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`, bypassing the `EmbeddableHost` model’s `before_validation` normalization that strips scheme/path (`sub!(/^https?:\/\//,'')`, `sub!(/\/.*$/,'')`). The diff also updates embed checks to `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)` and `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` extracts `uri.host` and queries `where("lower(host) = ?", host)`. If the legacy setting contained entries like `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234` (explicitly shown in the updated `embed_controller_spec` setup fabrications), those rows would be stored verbatim (and even violate the model’s host format), so lookups for `discourse.org` / `example.com` won’t match. This would break embedding for upgraded sites until the hosts are corrected/resaved.
